title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Comfey Old Maid Card - NM
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: This Pokémon TCG card features Comfey, a character from the Old Maid Super High Tension set. It is a standard-sized card made of card stock with a regular finish. The card is in Japanese and manufactured by Nintendo in 2023. It is suitable for ages 4 and up and is not autographed. The card is a great addition to any collection and perfect for any fan of the Pokémon TCG.
